build_cmds: cmake -S . -B build -DBUILD_CONFIG=mysql_release -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local/mysql -DINSTALL_LAYOUT=STANDALONE -DREPRODUCIBLE_BUILD=ON '-DCOMPILATION_COMMENT=ReadyStack build of Percona Server (GPL)' '-DCOMPILATION_COMMENT_SERVER=ReadyStack build of Percona Server (GPL)' -DWITH_SSL=system -DWITH_ZLIB=system -DWITH_ZSTD=system -DWITH_LZ4=system -DWITH_ICU=system -DWITH_PROTOBUF=bundled -DWITH_EDITLINE=bundled -DWITH_TIRPC=bundled -DWITH_CURL=system -DWITH_FIDO=none -DWITH_AUTHENTICATION_LDAP=OFF -DWITH_AUTHENTICATION_KERBEROS=OFF -DWITH_AUTHENTICATION_WEBAUTHN=OFF -DWITH_AUTHENTICATION_CLIENT_PLUGINS=OFF -DWITH_ROUTER=OFF -DWITH_UNIT_TESTS=OFF -DWITH_ROCKSDB=ON -DROCKSDB_DISABLE_AVX2=1 -DROCKSDB_DISABLE_MARCH_NATIVE=1 -DWITH_PAM=ON -DWITH_PERCONA_TELEMETRY=OFF -DWITH_JS_LANG=OFF -DWITH_NDB=OFF -DWITHOUT_NDBCLUSTER_STORAGE_ENGINE=ON -DWITH_SYSTEMD=OFF -DWITH_NUMA=OFF -DWITHOUT_THREAD_POOL=1 -DINSTALL_MYSQLTESTDIR= -DINSTALL_STATIC_LIBRARIES=OFF

J=$(nproc); M=$(awk '/MemAvailable/ {print int($2/2097152)}' /proc/meminfo); [ "$M" -ge 1 ] || M=1; [ "$M" -lt "$J" ] && J=$M; echo "compiling with $J parallel jobs"; cmake --build build --parallel "$J"

cmake --install build --component Test --prefix /tmp/test-component && (cd /tmp/test-component && find . \( -type f -o -type l \) -print0) | (cd /usr/local/mysql && xargs -0 -r rm -f) && rm -rf /tmp/test-component
source._note: BUILD_CONFIG=mysql_release is upstream's release profile (it turns on REPRODUCIBLE_BUILD for release build types and requires libaio), and the flags follow our MySQL build plus the Percona features of Percona's own release build (build-ps/build-binary.sh at the tag): MyRocks (-DWITH_ROCKSDB=ON, with AVX2 and -march=native off so the binary runs on any x86-64 host and builds the same everywhere) and the PAM authentication plugin (-DWITH_PAM=ON). Left out on purpose: Percona's telemetry (-DWITH_PERCONA_TELEMETRY=OFF: the server component and the call-home agent of Percona's packages report to check.percona.com) and JavaScript stored programs (-DWITH_JS_LANG=OFF: they need a V8 build (build-ps/build_v8.sh) that is not part of the source tree). COMPILATION_COMMENT names this build in @@version_comment. -DWITHOUT_THREAD_POOL=1 drops Oracle's thread_pool plugin as in our MySQL build; Percona's own thread pool (thread_handling=pool-of-threads) is part of mysqld.

source_prep: git submodule update --init --depth 1 --recursive --jobs 4 && test -f storage/rocksdb/rocksdb/CMakeLists.txt && test -f extra/coredumper/CMakeLists.txt && test -f extra/libkmip/CMakeLists.txt && test -d extra/jwt-cpp/include
